title: Exact payment reconciliation projection domain

decision.boundary: Derive deterministic payment-status truth from one exact FOOD-005J payable-assessment version and a bounded collection of normalized immutable payment-evidence snapshots.
decision.normalizedInput: FOOD-005K does not create a persisted generic payment entity. It consumes transient normalized snapshots derived later by trusted adapters.
decision.sourceFamiliesRemainSeparate: FOOD-005F electronic confirmation and FOOD-005I cash evidence remain independent canonical source families.
decision.idempotencyBoundary: Duplicate source identity/version references are rejected within one reconciliation input only. Global uniqueness and durable idempotency remain deferred.
decision.notOrderMutation: Payment status does not mutate FOOD-005E order state and cannot revive cancellation.
decision.notFulfillment: Paid-in-full grants no preparation, reservation, scheduling, dispatch, delivery or handoff authority.
decision.notSale: Paid-in-full creates no completed-sale, revenue, accounting, inventory, rewards or verified-purchase authority.

evidence.duplicateRule: sourceKind + sourceId + sourceVersion unique within one reconciliation.
evidence.orderRule: Every evidence snapshot binds exact assessment physical-order ID/version and merchandise subtotal.
evidence.currencyRule: Every evidence amount uses exact assessment amountDue currency.

statusDerivation.no-payment-due: amountDue equals zero and evidenceTotal equals zero.
statusDerivation.unpaid: amountDue is positive and evidenceTotal equals zero.
statusDerivation.partially-paid: evidenceTotal is positive and below amountDue.
statusDerivation.paid-in-full: amountDue is positive and evidenceTotal exactly equals amountDue.

invariants: overpaid != refund owed or change due
all money arithmetic fails closed beyond safe integer range
source evidence order binding must exactly match assessment order
